composition_subtypes.role: Sort people by (sight, -index) and assign seats in row-major order
Sort each row by original index to count inversions with segment tree

payload.core_composition_summary: Greedy seat assignment by sorted order then inversion counting via per-row sorting and data structure.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a greedy ordering (by sight and descending original index) to assign seats, then counts inversions per row using a second sorting, illustrating coordination of greedy and sorting mechanisms.
